primary.$description: Headings and body text on any surface.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons placed on an accent or status fill.

disabled.$description: Text on unavailable controls. Exempt from contrast rules.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the inverse surface.

raised.$description: Cards, sheets and panels that sit on the page.

sunken.$description: Inset areas such as thumbnails and wells.

hover.$description: Rows and neutral controls while hovered.

pressed.$description: Rows and neutral controls while pressed.

inverse.$description: Tooltips and inverted buttons: the opposite of the page.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers and dialogs that overlap content. Always paired with a border.

scrim.$description: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs. Neutral 950 at 50% in light, 70% in dark.

dot.$description: Dots of the dotted grid on the page background. Decoration only: never behind text on its own. Provisional values.

divider.$description: Lines between rows in a list.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring on any interactive element.

default.$description: The one look-here fill: primary button, call to action, callout, focus of attention.

subtle.$description: Tinted background for highlighted or selected areas.

fill.$description: Something is in progress: thinking, acting. Strong fill for badges and indicators; pair with text/on-accent.

text.$description: Something is in progress: thinking, acting. Text and icons on page or raised surfaces.

subtle.$description: Something is in progress: thinking, acting. Tinted background for banners and rows; pair with the matching status text.

fill.$description: Something finished successfully. Strong fill for badges and indicators; pair with text/on-accent.

text.$description: Something finished successfully. Text and icons on page or raised surfaces.

subtle.$description: Something finished successfully. Tinted background for banners and rows; pair with the matching status text.

fill.$description: Needs attention or review; a warning. Strong fill for badges and indicators; pair with text/on-accent.

text.$description: Needs attention or review; a warning. Text and icons on page or raised surfaces.

subtle.$description: Needs attention or review; a warning. Tinted background for banners and rows; pair with the matching status text.

fill.$description: Something failed, or an action is destructive. Strong fill for badges and indicators; pair with text/on-accent.

text.$description: Something failed, or an action is destructive. Text and icons on page or raised surfaces.

subtle.$description: Something failed, or an action is destructive. Tinted background for banners and rows; pair with the matching status text.
